breadth.label: Advance / decline
breadth.help: (Advancers − decliners) ÷ total stocks in the universe.

breadth.label: Above 20 EMA
breadth.help: Share of stocks closing above their 20-period EMA.

breadth.label: Above 200 EMA
breadth.help: Share of stocks above their 200-period EMA — the long-term trend filter.

breadth.label: RSI above 60
breadth.help: Share of stocks with 14-period RSI above 60 (strong momentum).

breadth.label: Above daily pivot
breadth.help: Share of stocks trading above the classic floor pivot point.

breadth.label: Near 52-week high
breadth.help: Share of stocks within 5% of their 52-week high.

breadth.label: Recent breakout
breadth.help: Share of stocks with a qualified base breakout in the last 20 sessions.
